source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 26 to 30
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 23, 2026 · 18 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! The Séance of Blake Manor Raw Fury ☆☆☆☆☆ 133 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass The Séance of Blake Manor – October 27Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere It is October 28th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman. What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world – waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead. Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together. Mouthwashing CRITICAL REFLEX ☆☆☆☆☆ 506 ★★★★★ $12.99 $10.39 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Mouthwashing – October 29XBOX Play Anywhere Mouthwashing is a first-person horror game following the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter. Who could have known what good ol’ Captain Curly was capable of? Guess he thought his crew dying alongside him was only right. But some men can’t even kill themselves properly. Maimed, limbless and unable to speak, but alive, Curly is now at the mercy of the crew he has doomed to a slow death. The Wolf Among Us Remastered Telltale ☆☆☆☆☆ 142 ★★★★★ $24.99 $19.99 Get it now The Wolf Among Us Remastered – October 29 Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning. Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered – the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before – honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players. Queen's Domain Future Friends Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 125 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now Queen’s Domain – October 30 Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) Funktronic Labs ☆☆☆☆☆ 169 ★★★★★ $12.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) – October 26Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Scramble Knights Online, an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training. Terrible Lizards Digital Pajamas ☆☆☆☆☆ 934 ★★★★★ $24.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Terrible Lizards – October 29Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Something is very wrong at Dalton’s Dinos, the once must-see Route 66 roadside attraction baking under the New Mexico sun. The staff have vanished, but a mysterious voice on the telephone you find in the attraction begs you for help to find a missing child. You’d leave… if your car hadn’t died miles from anywhere. It’s 1992. No cell phones. No rideshares. No help coming, and you’ll soon find that you are not alone inside the attraction. Ayasa: Shadows of Silence Aya Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 6 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now Ayasa: Shadows of Silence – October 26 Step into the eerie world of Ayasa, a dark tale that blends quests, horror, and puzzles into a haunting journey. Without a single spoken word, the story is told through pantomime, surreal imagery, and a soundtrack composed by Komitas. You will navigate six symbolic lands Faith, Hope, Love, Greed, Indifference, and Betrayal—each corrupted by darkness. Every choice you make, every act of compassion or indifference, may lead to an unexpected ending. Will you restore balance or become the very force you sought to defeat? PAO PAO (Game Preview) Dreland Enterprises ☆☆☆☆☆ 5 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Free Trial PAO PAO – October 26 Explore a lively town where every day brings something new. Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening. With changing weather, seasons and a full day-night cycle, PAO PAO is always a little different. Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services Destroyer Doggo ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services – October 27XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services, where things don’t need to be perfect — just a little cleaner, a little calmer, and a little more you. Whether you’re curled up with a podcast or just need something peaceful to help the world feel quieter, this gentle 2D pressure washing game is here for you. No timers, no stress, just pastel pixel art, soft sounds, and the satisfying swish of clean water. Bloom Busters UBrothers ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Bloom Busters – October 27Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Bloomland is under attack. A toxic infestation has twisted its gardens and filled them with cheeky mutated creatures – and Jimmy and Jessie are ready to clean up the mess. Bloom Busters is a frantic, old-school action arcade adventure with a distinctive isometric perspective. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op as you bash and blast through

source.title: Marathon Symbiosis update launches December 8, adding new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, and more
source.evidenceText: November 10, 2026November 11, 2026 Marathon Symbiosis update launches December 8, adding new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, and more 4 0 52 Like this Get first details on the updated Perimeter zone, new Bishop Runner shell, and more. Tim Turi (he/him) Content Communications Manager, Sony Interactive Entertainment Marathon‘s Symbiosis update arrives December 8, bringing new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, a Runner shell, and expanded areas to explore on Tau Ceti IV. Today we’ve got first details on the updated Perimeter zone, Expedition mode, and more. Play Video What’s new in Marathon: Symbiosis Updated Perimeter zone: Fungal growth and alien life have transformed Perimeter, introducing new playable spaces including the underground Burrows and submerged Reservoir. Runners will also encounter the Tick Queen, who lurks deep beneath the surface. Expedition: Phase 1 of a new PvE-only mode built around a three-run series. Play solo or with a crew, face new combat and environmental challenges without PvP threats, and use Flash Boosts to shape your build during a run. Deathmatch (Beta): An experimental PvP mode featuring bite-sized 3v3 Team Deathmatch matches. Two crews compete for points without risking their permanent loadouts. Limbo: A new social space where Runners can connect, test weapons and gear in firing ranges, and challenge each other in a dueling pit. Bishop Runner shell: A new Runner shell built around the fantasy of a fast, surgical blade-wielding robot. New weapons: The V17 Flamethrower brings short-range area denial, while the Maverick introduces a new revolver archetype with a hand-cannon feel. Open Play Week begins December 8 Players can experience Marathon during Open Play Week, running December 8 – 15, alongside the launch of Symbiosis. Marathon is available now on PS5, with full cross-play and cross-save support.** The Symbiosis update launches December 8 for all players. * Gameplay requires internet access and paid-for subscription on console (sold separately). **Cross-save requires an internet connection, and for each system you play on: 1) a copy of the Marathon game compatible with your system (other versions sold separately); and 2) system network account linked to your Bungie.net account.
